etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from French parvenu, past participle of parvenir, from Latin perveniō (“arrive, reach”).
senses: A person who has risen, climbed up, or has been promoted to a higher social class, especially through acquisition of wealth, privileges, or political authority but has not gained social acceptance by those within that new class.
Being a parvenu; also, like, having the characteristics of, or associated with a parvenu.
